evidenceLayout: tmp/mod004/<planId>/ holds each plan's full command logs. Each plan's Progress Log records every command, its exit status and its log path. Retries go under tmp/mod004/<planId>/attempt-<n>/. tmp/ is gitignored and must stay untracked. A missing or truncated log is not a pass.

executionModel.commitOwner: The orchestrator commits after each wave. Workers never commit, stash, checkout, reset, branch, push or merge.
executionModel.retryPolicy: If cargo fails inside another concurrent plan's files, wait about 60 s and retry, up to 10 times, then record a blocker in the plan's Progress Log.
executionModel.editProtocol: Before each edit, re-read the file and record its sha256 and an intent snapshot in the Progress Log. If the file drifted, re-apply only this plan's own change. After editing, record the post-edit sha256. Never edit outside writePaths.
executionModel.serialReconciliation: MOD004-40 owns crate-wide cargo fmt, the parent-plan and README updates, the Status lines of MOD004-20/21/22/30/40, and any cross-plan repair.

reviewContext.userProblem: UGen edges name only a source node, so a node cannot expose main/aux or stereo outputs to other UGens. 36 prelude templates instantiate an engine twice to recover main and aux, stereo sampler output collapses to mono through edges, voice-local stereo effects copy-and-average a mono input, and main/aux voices bypass ordinary pan (design-docs/specs/design-mutable-audio.md:753-772).
constraints: Follow the committed MOD-004 design and the owner decisions resolved 2026-09-29; do not reopen them.
The audio callback stays allocation-free and bounded; decode_graph and template build use fixed-size arrays only.
Every touched Rust file stays under 1000 lines, split per .agents/skills/rust-coding-standards/.
Existing templates render bit-identically (golden_digests.txt) unless migrated with a render-equivalence test.
Keep the 48 input/control slots, 256 node cap, 1024 edge cap and MAX_VOICE_FX; channel buffers are capped at 512 plus 2 discard slices.

Write only under src/, tests/, examples/, design-docs/, impl-plans/, verification/ and tmp/. Workers do not change git state; the orchestrator commits without Co-Authored-By or tool attribution and does not push.
cargo runs with CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true; nextest with NEXTEST_STATUS_LEVEL=fail NEXTEST_FAILURE_OUTPUT=immediate-final NEXTEST_HIDE_PROGRESS_BAR=1.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Selection is calling the node value with an output keyword ({p :aux}) or index ({p 1}); no dot syntax, so the grammar does not change (owner decision, design:1173-1175).
The output index is an edge property (Edge.output), not a split node, to avoid node-cap pressure and extra copies (design:1128-1132).
Stereo and main/aux voices use unity-center balance; mono voices keep equal-power pan, so existing mono renders are unchanged (design:1176-1178).

Only the nine templates whose main and aux are simultaneous outputs of one engine state migrate; phase-pair-voice and resonator-voice are ineligible because their per-node state differs (design:1179-1182, 1196-1199).
No legacy graph decoder: a new instrument tag b'V' replaces b'I', and b'I' is rejected with BadRecord, because peers must share a revision (design:1183-1186, 1193-1195).
sample-play shape is fixed per node kind (:mono default, :stereo) rather than derived from the resource, so the prelude sampler keeps its sound (design:1200-1203).
Voice-local effects follow their subject's shape, so mono voice effects stay bit-identical (design:1204-1206).
Unconsumed outputs above index 0 write to shared discard slices rather than being rejected; slices are dense in topological order (design:1081-1094, 1207-1211).
intentionalTradeoffs: Old duplicate-node forms and aux-out/out3/out4 taps stay valid; duplication is kept where migration is not provably bit-identical.
Mixed-revision native/browser graph exchange is unsupported.
Legacy aux-out voices switch to balance pan: bit-identical at center, off-center pan follows the balance formula.
The pair and stereo kernels run only when output 1 is consumed, so unselected graphs keep the exact mono code path.
supportedEdgeCases: Unselected use of a multi-output node means output 0 on every edge.
A root {p :aux} ends in one Add sink fed by output 1.
Stereo-to-mono edges and stereo plus aux-out are definition-time errors; selection in a bus body is a lowering type error.
513 channel slices fail at definition with GraphTooLarge naming the 512-buffer cap; 508 slices define; Template::build re-checks with BuildError::TooManyBuffers.
Corrupt shape bytes or edge outputs, b'I' and unknown tags are rejected with BadRecord without allocation.
Rate and block-partition invariance and callback allocation probes hold with multi-output nodes and stereo voice effects.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Dynamic channel counts, more than 4 outputs per node, more than 2 channels per output, surround layouts and implicit up/downmix.
Bus/master processing, out3/out4 stems, mono pan and the private spatial balance_gains.
Mutable source parity certification for engines whose topology is now represented.
Migrating templates beyond the nine, and MOD-005/006 work.
reviewContext.sourceSyntaxNote: The design writes selection as (p :aux) in s-expression notation. In .vact source, ( ) is rejected by the lexer (paren-form), so tests and templates must use {p :aux} (or p :aux) and let p {...}. MOD004-20's sel-a test pins the working form, and MOD004-30 copies it.
requiredOutcomes: MOD004-20: {p :aux}, {p :main} and {p 1} lower to one node with edge output k; an unselected use means output 0; definition-time failures not-callable, unknown-field, type and arity; the checker types (ugen kw|int) as ugen and reports type-mismatch otherwise; a selected root with k>0 adds one Add sink; selection in a bus body is a lowering type error; shape, layout and capacity errors occur at definition time.
MOD004-21: tag G_INST = b'V', one shape byte per node, one output byte per edge, an allocation-free decode cross-check; b'I' and any unknown tag give BadRecord; bus and master bytes are unchanged.

MOD004-22: dense channel slices in a (MAX_AUDIO_BUFFERS + DISCARD_SLICES) * max_block arena; BuildError::TooManyBuffers; the pair and stereo kernels run only when output 1 is consumed; stereo Mul/Add and stereo voice effects have no downmix; prim::balance_gains for stereo and main/aux voices; mono voices keep pan_gains.
MOD004-30: exactly nine templates migrate, each bit-identical to its old form in main and aux; only their nine graph lines change in golden_digests.txt.
MOD004-40: native and browser shape and render parity, allocation probes, rate/block invariance, the full acceptance command set, and the MOD-004A..F closeout.
nonGoals: Grammar or reader changes, and a validate_ugen_output in src/ns/insts.rs.
A legacy graph-payload decoder or mixed-revision support.
Changes to bus/master processing, the out3/out4 stems, mono pan, or the private spatial balance_gains.
Migrating any template beyond the nine.
